question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5
solution:
The correct answer is '**about**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage mentions Mother informing Spiro of the situation with the cases held by the Customs.
 
• "**About**" is used to indicate the subject of the conversation, fitting the context appropriately.
 
• Other options ("**within**", "**from**", "**behind**") do not correctly convey informing or discussing the situation of the cases.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

Complete Passage: *He knew everyone on the island. Whenever his car stopped, half a dozen voices would__ shout out his name. Policemen, agricultural labourers of low social status and priests waved and smiled __as__ he passed; everyone greeted him as a brother. They respected his honesty, and belligerence, and above all, they adored his typically Greek scorn and fearlessness when dealing with any __form__ of Governmental red tape. On arrival, two of our cases containing linen and other things had been __confiscated__ by the Customs on the curious ground that they were merchandise. So, when we moved out to the villa and the problem of bed linen arose, Mother told Spiro __about__ our cases in the Customs and asked for his advice.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Within (के अंदर): Indicates a location or time frame, not fitting for discussing a subject.
 
• From (से): Indicates a point of origin or source, not appropriate for the context of informing about.
 
• Behind (पीछे): Indicates a position, not relevant in this context.
